metadata.title: Invoke-ExportVideoLogREDFISH
metadata.description: iDRAC Cmdlet using Redfish API with OEM extension to export either boot capture videos or crash capture video locally. NOTE: iDRAC copies boot capture videos to a zip file and prompts you to download using your default browser. If needed to watch the video capture files (dvc format), download the video player from the iDRAC GUI/Maintenance/Troubleshooting page.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Invoke-ExportVideoLogREDFISH' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$idrac_password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
